review_method: Study figures (10): unchanged accepted figures from 2026-10-15. Equation figures (24): drawn from the lesson formulas and rasterized from their SVG twins with headless Microsoft Edge, inspected in contact sheets and corrected; PPTX files reopened with python-pptx. PowerPoint and LibreOffice were not available, so the equation PPTX files were not rendered by an Office renderer.
limitations: Equation figures illustrate the adopted lesson models; illustrative values are labelled in each figure.
Study figures retain their original quantitative source data.
